topics.name: LLM alignment and preference learning
topics.summary: Alignment papers study preference optimization, reward modeling, and refusal behavior across language and multimodal agents, using comparisons, critiques, and safety tests to balance capability with reliability.

topics.name: LLM evaluation and alignment diagnostics
topics.summary: Evaluation work builds stress tests for alignment and perception, showing how prompt format, infrared scenes, and benchmark design can alter apparent model quality.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical AI systems
topics.summary: Clinical systems papers apply multimodal learning to surgery, pathology, oncology, and care workflows, combining imaging, language, and patient context for decision support.

topics.name: Clinical AI evaluation and deployment
topics.summary: Healthcare evaluation studies compare models on clinical tasks and deployment constraints, emphasizing calibration, clinician-facing usefulness, and failure cases rather than aggregate accuracy alone.

topics.name: Language-model representation learning
topics.summary: Language-model representation studies analyze internal geometry, tokenization, and latent features with probing or mechanistic tools to explain reasoning and transfer.

topics.name: LLM adaptation and training
topics.summary: Adaptation work tunes language models with efficient objectives, curriculum, and low-resource data, measuring how continued training changes generalization and alignment.

topics.name: Agentic multimodal systems
topics.summary: Agentic multimodal systems combine perception, planning, tools, and interaction, with experiments on long-horizon tasks, embodied environments, and model-based coordination.

topics.name: Multimodal benchmark analysis
topics.summary: Benchmark studies test multimodal agents on challenging reasoning and interaction suites, using executable criteria or human judgments to expose capability gaps.

topics.name: Medical imaging representation learning
topics.summary: Medical representation methods learn transferable features from imaging and clinical signals, using self-supervision, graph structure, or pretrained backbones for segmentation and prediction.

topics.name: Contrastive representation learning
topics.summary: Contrastive-learning papers align modalities or views with positive and hard-negative pairs, evaluating transfer, retrieval, and robustness across vision, language, and scientific data.

topics.name: LLM compression and quantization
topics.summary: Compression research reduces language-model cost with quantization, pruning, sparsity, and low-rank updates, tracking accuracy, memory, and hardware throughput.

topics.name: Medical AI training and adaptation
topics.summary: Medical adaptation studies use fine-tuning, domain transfer, and synthetic data to fit imaging models to new scanners, tasks, or patient populations.

topics.name: Agent memory and long-horizon planning
topics.summary: Agent-memory work addresses long-horizon planning with episodic stores, hierarchical state, and explicit credit assignment, testing whether agents retain goals and recover from mistakes.

topics.name: AI security, privacy, and robustness
topics.summary: Security research examines adversarial inputs, hidden behaviors, privacy leakage, and model misuse, pairing attacks with detection, robust training, or access controls.

topics.name: Aerial and marine navigation control
topics.summary: Aerial and marine control papers combine visual sensing, dynamics models, and learned policies for UAV or underwater navigation under disturbance and partial observability.

topics.name: Agent evaluation and workflow reliability
topics.summary: Agent evaluation studies diagnose planning, coding, and tool-use failures with traces, controlled environments, and recovery metrics, separating local competence from end-to-end reliability.

topics.name: Human-centered explainable AI
topics.summary: Explainable-AI work connects predictions to features, evidence, or user-facing rationales, evaluating attribution stability and whether explanations improve decisions in applied settings.

topics.name: Navigation and control evaluation
topics.summary: Navigation evaluations compare planners and controllers in simulated or real flight and marine scenarios, emphasizing safety margins, generalization, and closed-loop behavior.

topics.name: Learning theory and convergence
topics.summary: Learning-theory papers derive convergence, regret, or generalization guarantees for online learning and representation methods, clarifying assumptions behind practical algorithms.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting
topics.summary: Forecasting work models demand, finance, disease, and operational sequences with temporal graphs or probabilistic predictors, emphasizing limited history and changing regimes.

topics.name: Inference memory and latency optimization
topics.summary: Inference systems optimize KV memory, token budgets, and scheduling for long-context or multimodal models, measuring throughput and quality under realistic serving workloads.

topics.name: Reasoning and instruction following
topics.summary: Reasoning studies improve instruction following with structured prompts, recursive inference, and verification, testing whether extra computation yields faithful and consistent solutions.

topics.name: Agent representations and world models
topics.summary: Agent-representation work learns latent state, memory, or world models for planning, studying controllability, abstraction, and the relation between internal predictions and action.

topics.name: Graph representation and network analysis
topics.summary: Graph methods learn network structure and dynamics with message passing, spectral or temporal representations, evaluating link prediction, diffusion, and robustness on relational data.

topics.name: Speech, music, and audio modeling
topics.summary: Audio research covers music understanding, speech judging, and acoustic-scene generation, using multimodal encoders or generative models to preserve expressive and paralinguistic cues.

topics.name: Human feedback and interactive learning
topics.summary: Human-feedback studies model interaction traces, demonstrations, and user preferences, evaluating how feedback changes adaptive interfaces and the generalization of learned behavior.

topics.name: Video motion understanding and synthesis
topics.summary: Video-generation work edits motion and synthesizes temporally coherent scenes, combining diffusion or structured representations with tests of identity, dynamics, and long-range consistency.

topics.name: Computational biology and chemistry
topics.summary: Computational biology papers model cells, genes, and molecules with graph, generative, or coarse-grained simulation methods, evaluating transfer to unseen perturbations and chemical spaces.

topics.name: Embodied navigation representations
topics.summary: Embodied-navigation studies align visual-language representations with vehicle geometry and future viewpoints, improving route choice and transfer from simulation to physical platforms.

topics.name: Bandits and online reinforcement learning
topics.summary: Bandit and online-RL work studies exploration, partial observability, and verifiable rewards, using regret or sample-efficiency analyses to guide adaptive policy learning.

topics.name: Knowledge graphs and semantic networks
topics.summary: Knowledge-graph research supports intent inference, entity linking, and semantic exploration through structured relations, graph queries, and language-model-assisted interfaces.

topics.name: Navigation adaptation and safety
topics.summary: Navigation adaptation papers address uncertainty, human oversight, and cooperative sensing, using online learning or safety constraints to maintain control under changing conditions.

topics.name: Biological modeling and evaluation
topics.summary: Biological evaluation studies test cell and molecular predictors on held-out perturbations or modalities, comparing mechanistic priors with learned representations and uncertainty estimates.

topics.name: Information retrieval and legal RAG
topics.summary: Retrieval work grounds language models in legal and domain-specific sources, combining vector search, structured documents, and answer verification to reduce unsupported claims.

topics.name: Clinical AI applications
topics.summary: Clinical applications use agents and multimodal models for patient education, triage, and care coordination, with human-centered workflows and domain constraints shaping system design.

topics.name: Medical and language-model benchmark analysis
topics.summary: Medical and language-model benchmarks audit robustness, efficiency, and safety on specialized tasks, showing why broad scores can miss clinically important failure modes.

topics.name: Robustness evaluation and defense
topics.summary: Robustness studies evaluate corruption, adversarial perturbation, and distribution shift, comparing model sensitivity with defenses based on augmentation, calibration, or architectural changes.

topics.name: Efficient multimodal inference
topics.summary: Efficient multimodal inference combines token pruning, quantized execution, and routing policies, reporting trade-offs among latency, memory traffic, and task quality.

topics.name: Diffusion image generation and editing
topics.summary: Diffusion studies control image synthesis and editing with artist, layout, or semantic conditions, assessing fidelity, personalization, and the cost of iterative generation.

topics.name: Medical AI evaluation
topics.summary: Medical evaluation work compares segmentation and decision models across sites or modalities, emphasizing reproducibility, calibration, and clinically meaningful error analysis.

topics.name: Diffusion sampling and physical simulation
topics.summary: Diffusion and physics papers study sampling dynamics for images and physical fields, balancing computational tractability with distributional fidelity and stable training.

topics.name: 3D medical and human motion generation
topics.summary: Generative medical and human-motion models synthesize anatomy or articulated movement, using structured conditioning and simulation-oriented metrics to assess realism and control.

topics.name: Probabilistic causal modeling
topics.summary: Probabilistic modeling work studies causal structure, latent variables, and uncertainty, using Bayesian or graphical formulations to separate observational fit from identifiable intervention effects.
